## ResolutionRequest interface

One reference, already authorized and validated, handed to an executor to resolve into the record or records it denotes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ResolutionRequest
```

## Remarks

The runtime has already run the reference through the full invocation pipeline as a call of the target resource's `get` operation (a single reference) or `list` operation (a collection reference): permission, governance, and approval. Like [ExecutionRequest](./core.executionrequest.md)<!-- -->, it carries no credential or authority.
